goal: Build the campaign overview and the one progress computation: campaign_progress as the single source of funnel, outcome mix, caller rollup, summary counts and recent activity, plus the Overview stat cards and campaign table — scoped, fail-closed, and queued-excluded.
outcome: campaign_progress returns the five-bucket funnel (Assigned, Attempted, Reached, Confirmed, Never attempted), the outcome mix by status_group, the per-caller rollup, the summary counts and recent activity in one call; the Overview screen shows the scoped stat cards and the campaign table with an actionable no-campaign empty state; a Preacher or Assistant never widens to program scope; a missing scope is refused; a queued disposition is not counted until its replay lands.

requirements.statement: ONE FUNCTION, ONE SET OF DEFINITIONS — never recompute a definition in the client.

SECURITY: SECURITY INVOKER, SET search_path = public, pg_temp, EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated and granted to service_role only. A program_scope=false with a null scope id raises; only Admin passes true.
Funnel and campaign counts are assignment-grain; leaderboard and activity are log-grain.
A QUEUED DISPOSITION IS NOT COUNTED until replay. Say so in the UI.
No campaign empty state is drawn — implement it (UX-DR24).
